query: I just picked up a new loaf of sourdough from the bakery down the street this morning, it has this perfect crispy crust and they added little rosemary and garlic bits inside that taste so good when you toast it with a bit of salted butter. I also finally got around to repotting my snake plant that’s been looking a little sad lately, I found this really nice terracotta pot with hand-painted blue patterns that fits it perfectly. Oh right, I’m having some issues with my phone right now—airplane mode is turned on, my SIM card is locked with a PIN, and I think the SIM card might be unseated, I can’t get any mobile service at all.
